title: Reading CSV files
summary: The csv module's reader and DictReader, why split(",") is not enough, and converting text fields to numbers.
hints: Open CSV files with `open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8")`; the csv module handles line endings itself. `read_rows`: `return list(csv.reader(f))`. `read_records`: `return list(csv.DictReader(f))`; DictReader uses the first row as the keys.
Every field comes back as a string. `column_total`: `sum(float(row[column]) for row in csv.DictReader(f))`. A missing column raises `KeyError` by itself, which is what the tests want.

`find_by`: a list comprehension over `csv.DictReader(f)` keeping rows where `row[column] == value`. `headers`: `next(csv.reader(f), [])` reads just the first row (or gives `[]` for an empty file) without reading the rest.
